en: Black‑and‑white historical street scene showing a wide cobblestone avenue with horse‑drawn carts loaded with sacks moving along the road and several pedestrians, including children, on the sidewalks. On the left is a fenced garden or park with dense trees; on the right stands a row of ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings. Wooden poles with early electrical or telegraph wires line the street. People wear late 19th–early 20th century European clothing, including bowler hats and long dresses. The image resembles an old photographic postcard but shows no visible caption or printed text.
